changes.description: Added middleware tracking for final-looking output artifacts written as candidates/guesses/approximations, plus a one-time recovery turn that asks for an independent confirmation before finalizing. Reinforced the same rule in the system prompt, tool description, and long-term memory.
changes.failure_pattern: Extraction, visual/geometric decoding, and quantitative fitting tasks finalized plausible candidate outputs without independent confirmation; observed in gcode-to-text writing a pangram candidate, raman-fitting writing candidate Lorentzian parameters, and likely related video/extraction failures.
changes.why_this_component: The failure occurred at decision/finalization time after ordinary shell commands succeeded; middleware can detect candidate artifact writes structurally and force one corrective turn, while prompt/tool/memory guidance helps the model avoid creating uncertain deliverables in the first place. A task-specific tool would be too narrow and a global final gate would risk broad regressions.

changes.description: Added a scoped final-check gate for service, Git/SSH, webserver, QEMU, host/port, and deployment-hook tasks. It injects one recovery turn before finalization requiring the exact client-facing command/URL/host/branch/path after the last cleanup/reset, not merely on-disk or local-file evidence.
changes.failure_pattern: Service and Git deployment tasks completed with incomplete or stale exact-interface evidence after cleanup/reset; configure-git-webserver verified a local file clone and 127.0.0.1 curl rather than the requested host/remote form, and git-multibranch downgraded final evidence to on-disk checks after an earlier end-to-end test.
changes.why_this_component: The correct behavior depends on recognizing a class of user requests and interrupting premature finalization only for that class. Scoped middleware avoids enabling the broad final gate for all tasks, while prompt/tool text tells the model exactly what evidence to gather.

changes.description: Strengthened the system prompt to require compact baseline implementations for single-file parser/filter/converter tasks before broad all-edge-case designs.
changes.failure_pattern: The filter-js-from-html timeout trace spent most time in long model generations for an over-large first implementation and later checks, despite the task being a small single-file HTML filtering script.
changes.why_this_component: The timeout was dominated by model-generation time rather than shell runtime, so command timeouts cannot address it directly. A prompt-level small-first rule targets generation strategy with minimal implementation risk.

continuation_repair.label: cycle5-regression-repair
continuation_repair.basis: Nine cycle-5 pass-to-fail regressions plus persistent failure traces, using only allowed agent traces and reward summaries.
changes: Detect uncertainty only when a successful command actually writes a final artifact; do not infer it from output text or mere path mentions.
Block explicit placeholders from required final paths and keep unverified candidates under /tmp.
Back up SQLite databases, WAL files, and sidecars before the first potentially state-mutating open in recovery tasks.
Add scoped exact-schema and quantitative-threshold final checks with independent-oracle and safety-margin requirements.
Require genuinely distinct confirmation rather than repeated windows or re-fits of one ambiguous source.
Use a higher shell-progress threshold for complex recovery, training, build, vision, and fitting tasks.
continuation_repair.evaluation_scope: Fresh 26-task continuation: nine regressions rerun plus seventeen previously unfinished tasks. Results must be deduplicated by task and labeled infrastructure-adjusted continuation, not an official Terminal-Bench score.

cycle6_high_confidence_repair.basis: Reward-only outcomes plus allowed cleaned agent traces, including successful prior-run traces for contrast; no verifier messages, result/ctrf payloads, hidden tests, test stdout, or exception contents were read.

changes.evidence: model-extraction-relu-logits had already recovered all 20 row directions with cosine 1.0, but the guard blocked /app/steal.py because legitimate source contained dummy/fake terminology.
changes.action: Treat dummy/fake as soft placeholders that remain blocked for final data artifacts but not source-code files; keep strong UNKNOWN/PLACEHOLDER/TODO/TBD blocking for every required path.

changes.evidence: The failing run switched among incompatible axes and finalized raw-coordinate peaks; a successful infrastructure-recovery run used shift=1e7/raw_x and fitted graphene G/2D near 1580/2670 cm^-1.
changes.action: Add a one-time scoped final gate that requires an explicit fixed axis formula and physical-domain peak check.

changes.evidence: protein-assembly emitted ACGNT by encoding PDB modified-residue X as NGC; the successful run resolved chromophore precursors and emitted A/C/G/T only.
changes.action: Require concrete synthesizable DNA and authoritative resolution of modified residues.

changes.evidence: The failing implementation passed real Gloo tests but omitted the non-initialized monkeypatched context and already-sharded row-input behavior covered by the successful implementation.
changes.action: Require dense-reference forward/input/weight/bias gradient checks in both real and monkeypatched contexts, with full/local inputs and edge shapes.

changes.evidence: The failed run shifted junctions through short coincidental overlaps despite exact string reconstruction; the successful run used explicit coding-part boundaries and high-fidelity overhang checks.
changes.action: Prefer biological junction boundaries and validate actual Type-IIS products and overhang properties.

excluded_as_too_risky: No global SAM/contour algorithm rule was added from one demo-specific failure.
The broad hidden-like synthetic check added by automatic evolution was removed because it could add work to every script task without a deterministic fix.
cycle6_high_confidence_repair.evaluation_scope: Fresh full Terminal-Bench 2.0 cycle 6 with baked-in infrastructure recovery aliases; report as infrastructure-adjusted, not an official Terminal-Bench score.
